name: echoes-of-eden
description: ECHOES OF EDEN — a single-player cinematic story FPS for the browser (Three.js + React)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=client && npm run typecheck --workspace=server
